name: Tnk_cameraInstance

name: Tnk_fieldInstance
note: RPTnkField::CreateInstance; grid and cell size read by stage map, blocks and weapons

name: Tnk_gameManagerInstance
note: RPTnkGameManager::CreateInstance; mode, stage and parameter file read everywhere

name: Tnk_stepTimerInstance
note: RPTnkStepTimer::CreateInstance; the scene's draw reads mSteps / mClear

name: Tnk_footmarkTexInstance
note: RPTnkFootmarkTex::CreateInstance (from RPTnkTankManager::CreateTanks); indexed by the tank model index

name: Tnk_cellWidth
note: field width / columns, written by RPTnkField::Reset; block size and grid placement

name: Tnk_cellDepth
note: field depth / rows, written by RPTnkField::Reset

name: Tnk_lightPos
note: (0, 10000, 0), Tnk_initLightPosConst; copied into light 0 by RPTnkScene::LoadResource

name: Tnk_cameraIntroStartPos
note: (0, 5, 120); intro start position and first path point (RPTnkCamera::SetMode 0)

name: Tnk_cameraIntroTarget
note: (0, 15, 0); intro look-at target, its Y is blended to the fixed target's in StateIntroMove

name: Tnk_cameraFixedUp
note: (0, 0, -1); initialised with the path constants, no reader found

name: Tnk_floorQuadBasis
note: same values; scaled into the floor quad matrices by RPTnkField's Draw* methods

name: Tnk_bgmTrackMasks
note: RPTnkBgmMix::ApplyTrackMask: indexed by (enemy count - 1) * 4 + strongest type - 1

name: Tnk_treadSoundIds
note: tread sound ids indexed by the tank sound's variant (Tnk_TankSound_updateTread)

name: Tnk_Tank_stateFuncs
note: idle, player control, enemy control, player stop, enemy stop; copied by the constructor

name: Tnk_ExGuide_stateFuncs
note: inside the 0x60-byte object 8035C2C0 (+0x30); copied by RPTnkExGuide::CreateInstance; first 0x30 bytes unknown

name: Tnk_SceneSound_vtable
note: scene sound object (derived from the shared scene sound base, vtable 803587D0)

name: Tnk_ActorSound_vtable
note: actor sound actor (derived from the shared sound actor, vtable 80358964)

name: Tnk_MineSound_vtable
note: mine sound actor (derived from the shared sound actor, vtable 80358964); dtk label is 0x448 bytes (vtable plus following data)

name: Tnk_TankSound_vtable
note: tank sound actor (derived from the shared sound actor); 0xE0-byte label
